8161.title: ACP instruction text retains command examples
8161.rootCauseOneLine: BB retains slash-command examples in generated skill descriptions and sends them as first-prompt ACP text; provider-specific expansion remains unverified.
8161.proposedFix: Validate an inert representation against the affected provider's real command parser before changing generated descriptions; preserve intentional user commands, paths and URLs.
8161.caveats: The transport exposure repeated in a second clean checkout, but Antigravity was unavailable and its command expansion was not executed. No fix PR is safe under the reproduction gate.
